drivers.theme: Hawkish Fed hike and credibility test
Rising long-end yields and term premium

parsed.rationale: Hawkish Fed hike and dot plot are largely priced but still cap risk appetite; long-end yields near 5% and policy-error worries weigh on duration-sensitive QQQ. AI capex earnings and tight credit support, but cautious tone and energy supply risk leave a modestly below-neutral skew, with base drift limiting one-week downside.
